sentences.zh: 淮南道，蓋古揚州之域，漢九江、廬江、江夏等郡，廣陵、六安國及南陽、汝南、臨淮之境。

translations.literal: The Huainan Circuit — comprised broadly the ancient Yangzhou region: in Han times the commanderies of Jiujiang, Lujiang, Jiangxia, and others, together with Guangling, the kingdom of Liu'an, and the territories of Nanyang, Runan, and Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan Circuit covered the ancient Yangzhou region—in Han times the commanderies of Jiujiang, Lujiang, Jiangxia, and the like, along with Guangling, the kingdom of Liu'an, and portions of Nanyang, Runan, and Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 揚、楚、滁、和、廬、壽、舒為星紀分，安、黃、申、光、蘄為鶉尾分。

translations.literal: Yang, Chu, Chu, He, Lu, Shou, and Shu belonged to the Xingji astrological allotment; An, Huang, Shen, Guang, and Qi belonged to the Quewei allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Yang, Chu, Chuzhou, He, Lu, Shou, and Shu fell within the Xingji division; An, Huang, Shen, Guang, and Qi within the Quewei division.

translations.literal: There were twelve prefectures and fifty-three counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised twelve prefectures and fifty-three counties.

sentences.zh: 其名山：灊、天柱、羅、塗、八公。

translations.literal: Its famous mountains: Qian, Tianzhu, Luo, Tu, and Bagong.
translations.idiomatic: Its notable mountains were Mount Qian, Mount Tianzhu, Mount Luo, Mount Tu, and Mount Bagong.

translations.literal: Its great rivers: Chu, Fei, and Lake Chaohu.
translations.idiomatic: Its principal waterways were the Chu River, the Fei River, and Lake Chaohu.

translations.literal: Its tax levies: zhi silk, silk gauze, cotton, and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Its assessed tribute in kind included zhi silk, silk gauze, cotton, and cloth.

translations.literal: Its presented tribute: silk, cloth, ramie, and kudzu fiber.
translations.idiomatic: Its court tribute comprised silk, cloth, ramie, and kudzu cloth.

sentences.zh: 揚州揚州廣陵郡，大都督府。

translations.literal: Yangzhou—Yangzhou: Guangling commandery, great-protectorate prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Prefecture (Guangling commandery), a great-protectorate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 本南兗州江都郡，武德七年曰邗州，以邗溝為名，九年更置揚州，天寶元年|742年更郡名。

translations.literal: Originally the Jiangdu commandery of southern Yan Prefecture; in the seventh year of Wude it was called Han Prefecture, named for the Han Canal; in the ninth year Yangzhou was re-established; in the first year of Tianbao (742) the commandery name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Jiangdu commandery under southern Yan Prefecture. In Wude 7 it was renamed Han Prefecture after the Han Canal; in year 9 Yangzhou was restored; in Tianbao 1 (742) the commandery designation was revised.

sentences.zh: 土貢：金、銀、銅器、青銅鏡、綿、蕃客袍錦、被錦、半臂錦、獨窠綾、殿額莞席、水兕甲、黃稑米、烏節米、魚臍、魚鮬、糖蟹、蜜薑、藕、鐵精、空青、白芒、兔絲、蛇粟、括蔞粉。

translations.literal: Local tribute: gold, silver, bronze vessels, bronze mirrors, cotton, foreign-guest robe brocades, quilt brocades, half-sleeve brocades, single-nest damask, hall-eave rush mats, water-rhinoceros hide armor, yellow glutinous rice, black-joint rice, fish milt, fish paste, sugar-preserved crabs, honeyed ginger, lotus root, refined iron, azurite, white cogongrass, dodder seed, snake millet, and kudzu starch powder.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included gold, silver, bronze ware, bronze mirrors, cotton, brocades for foreign merchants' robes and quilts, half-sleeve brocades, single-pattern damask, hall-eave rush mats, water-rhinoceros hide armor, yellow glutinous rice, black-joint rice, fish milt and paste, sugar-preserved crabs, honeyed ginger, lotus root, refined iron, azurite, white cogongrass, dodder seed, snake millet, and kudzu starch.

sentences.zh: 有丹楊監、廣陵監錢官二。

translations.literal: There were two mint superintendencies: Danyang and Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: It had two coin-mint superintendencies, at Danyang and Guangling.

sentences.zh: 戶七萬七千一百五，口四十六萬七千八百五十七。

translations.literal: Households: seventy-seven thousand one hundred five; persons: four hundred sixty-seven thousand eight hundred fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: It registered 77,105 households and 467,857 persons.

translations.literal: Seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: Seven counties.

translations.literal: It had Wuchang Army, established in Yuanhe year one.
translations.idiomatic: It had Wuchang Army, established in Yuanhe year one.

sentences.zh: 有南昌軍，乾元二年置，元和六年廢。南昌，望。本豫章。武德五年析置鍾陵縣，又置南昌縣，以南昌置孫州，八年州廢，又省南昌、鍾陵。寶應元年更豫章曰鍾陵。貞元中又更名。縣南有東湖，元和三年，刺史韋丹開南塘斗門以節江水，開陂塘以溉田。豐城，上。

translations.literal: It had Nanchang Army, established in Qianyuan year two and abolished in Yuanhe year six. Nanchang was eminent. It was originally Yuzhang. In Wude year five Zhongling County was divided off and established, and Nanchang County was also established; Sunzhou was established from Nanchang. In year eight the province was abolished, and Nanchang and Zhongling were also abolished. In Baoying year one Yuzhang was changed to Zhongling. During Zhenyuan the name was again changed. South of the county was East Lake; in Yuanhe year three the prefect Wei Dan opened the sluice gate of Southern Pond to regulate the river water and opened embanked ponds to irrigate fields. Fengcheng was upper-ranked.
translations.idiomatic: It had Nanchang Army, established in Qianyuan year two and abolished in Yuanhe year six. Nanchang was eminent. It was originally Yuzhang. In year eight the province was abolished, and Nanchang and Zhongling were also abolished. In Baoying year one Yuzhang was changed to Zhongling. During Zhenyuan the name was again changed. South of the county was East Lake; in Yuanhe year three the prefect Wei Dan opened the sluice gate of Southern Pond to regulate the river water and opened embanked ponds to irrigate fields. Fengcheng was upper-ranked.

sentences.zh: 金華，望。武德八年省長山縣入焉。垂拱四年曰金山，神龍元年復故名。有百沙山、金華山。有銅。義烏，緊。本烏傷，武德四年以縣置綢州，因綢巖為名，幷析置華川縣。七年州廢，省華川入烏傷，更名，來屬。永康，望。本縉雲，武德四年置麗州，八年州廢，更名，來屬。東陽，望。垂拱二年析義烏置。有歌山。蘭溪，緊。咸亨五年析金華置。有望雲山、大家山。武成，上。本武義，天授二年析永康置，更名，天祐中復曰武義。浦陽。

translations.literal: Jinhua was eminent. In Wude year eight Changshan County was abolished into it. In Chuigong year four it was called Jinshan, and in Shenlong year one its former name was restored. It had Baisha Mountain and Jinhua Mountain. It had copper. Yiwu was close-ranked. It was originally Wushang; in Wude year four Chouzhou was established from the county and named for Chou Cliff, and Huachuan County was also divided off and established. In year seven the province was abolished, Huachuan was abolished into Wushang, the name was changed, and it came under this prefecture. Yongkang was eminent. It was originally Jinyun; in Wude year four Lizhou was established, and in year eight the province was abolished, the name was changed, and it came under this prefecture. Dongyang was eminent. In Chuigong year two it was divided from Yiwu and established. It had Ge Mountain. Lanxi was close-ranked. In Xianheng year five it was divided from Jinhua and established. It had Wangyun Mountain and Dajia Mountain. Wucheng was upper-ranked. It was originally Wuyi; in Tianshou year two it was divided from Yongkang and established and its name was changed; during Tianyou it was again called Wuyi. Puyang.

sentences.zh: 有府一，曰浦陽。有義勝軍、靜海軍，寶應元年置。大曆二年廢靜海軍，元和六年廢義勝軍。中和二年復置義勝軍，乾寧三年曰鎮東。會稽，望。有南鎮會稽山，有祠。東北四十里有防海塘，自上虞江抵山陰百餘里，以畜水溉田，開元十年令李俊之增脩，大曆十年觀察使皇甫溫、大和六年令李左次又增脩之。有錫。山陰，緊。武德七年析會稽置，八年省，垂拱二年復置，大曆二年省，七年復置，元和七年省，十年復置。北三十里有越王山堰，貞元元年，觀察使皇甫政鑿山以畜洩水利，又東北二十里作朱儲斗門。北五里有新河，西北十里有運道塘，皆元和十年觀察使孟簡開。西北四十六里有新逕斗門，大和七年觀察使陸亘置。有鐵。諸暨，望。

translations.literal: It had one military establishment, called Puyang. It had Yisheng Army and Jinghai Army, established in Baoying year one. In Dali year two Jinghai Army was abolished, and in Yuanhe year six Yisheng Army was abolished. In Zhonghe year two Yisheng Army was restored, and in Qianning year three it was called Zhendong. Kuaiji was eminent. It had Kuaiji Mountain, the southern marchmount, with a shrine. Forty li northeast was the sea-defense embankment, running more than one hundred li from Shangyu River to Shanyin to store water and irrigate fields; in Kaiyuan year ten the magistrate Li Junzhi added repairs, in Dali year ten the surveillance commissioner Huangfu Wen added repairs, and in Dahe year six the magistrate Li Zuoci again added repairs. It had tin. Shanyin was close-ranked. In Wude year seven it was divided from Kuaiji and established; in year eight it was abolished; in Chuigong year two it was restored; in Dali year two it was abolished; in year seven it was restored; in Yuanhe year seven it was abolished; and in year ten it was restored. Thirty li north was Yuewangshan Weir; in Zhenyuan year one the surveillance commissioner Huangfu Zheng cut through the mountain to store and discharge water, and also made the Zhuchu sluice gate twenty li northeast. Five li north was New River, and ten li northwest was Yundao Pond, both opened by the surveillance commissioner Meng Jian in Yuanhe year ten. Forty-six li northwest was Xinjing sluice gate, established by the surveillance commissioner Lu Gen in Dahe year seven. It had iron. Zhuji was eminent.

sentences.zh: 有長洲軍，乾元二年置，大曆十二年廢。

translations.literal: It had Changzhou Army, established in Qianyuan year two and abolished in Dali year twelve.
translations.idiomatic: It had Changzhou Army, established in Qianyuan year two and abolished in Dali year twelve.

translations.literal: There was a Wuchang Army; it was established.
translations.idiomatic: There was a Wuchang Army; it was established.

translations.literal: There was a Changzhou Army; it was established and later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was a Changzhou Army; it was established and later abolished.

sentences.zh: 有府四，曰江平、新林、方山、邗江。

translations.literal: There were four military prefectures, called Jiangping, Xinlin, Fangshan, and Hanjiang.
translations.idiomatic: It had four military prefectures: Jiangping, Xinlin, Fangshan, and Hanjiang.

sentences.zh: 江都，望。東十一里有雷塘，貞觀十八年，長史李襲譽引渠，又築勾城塘，以溉田八百頃。有愛敬陂水門，貞元四年788年，節度使杜亞自江都西循蜀岡之右，引陂趨城隅以通漕，溉夾陂田。寶曆二年，漕渠淺，輸不及期，鹽鐵使王播自七里港引渠東注官河，以便漕運。有銅。江陽，望。貞觀十八年析江都置。有康令祠，咸通中大旱，令以身禱雨赴水死，天即大雨，民為立祠。六合，緊。武德七年析置石梁縣，以石梁、六合二縣置方州。貞觀元年州廢，省石梁，以六合來屬。有銅，有鐵。海陵，望。武德三年更名吳陵，以縣置吳州。七年州廢，復故名，來屬。景龍二年析置海安縣，開元十年省。有鹽官。高郵，上。

translations.literal: Jiangdu was eminent. Eleven li east was Leitang; in Zhenguan year eighteen the senior administrator Li Xiyu drew in a canal and also built Goucheng Pond to irrigate eight hundred qing of fields. It had the sluice gate of Aijing Embankment. In Zhenyuan year four, 788, the military governor Du Ya led the embankment from west of Jiangdu along the right side of Shugang toward the corner of the city to connect water transport and irrigate the fields beside the embankment. In Baoli year two the transport canal was shallow and shipments failed to arrive on schedule, so the salt-and-iron commissioner Wang Bo led a canal from Qili Harbor east into the official river to facilitate transport. It had copper. Jiangyang was eminent. In Zhenguan year eighteen it was divided from Jiangdu and established. It had the Shrine of Magistrate Kang; during Xiantong there was a great drought, and the magistrate prayed for rain with his own body, went into the water, and died, whereupon heavy rain immediately fell, and the people established a shrine for him. Liuhe was close-ranked. In Wude year seven Shiliang County was divided off and established, and Fangzhou was established from Shiliang and Liuhe counties. In Zhenguan year one the province was abolished; Shiliang was abolished, and Liuhe came under this prefecture. It had copper and iron. Hailing was eminent. In Wude year three its name was changed to Wuling, and Wuzhou was established from the county. In year seven the province was abolished, its former name was restored, and it came under this prefecture. In Jinglong year two Hai'an County was divided off and established; in Kaiyuan year ten it was abolished. It had salt offices. Gaoyou was upper-ranked.

sentences.zh: 江都，江陽，六合，海陵，高郵，上。

translations.literal: Jiangdu, Jiangyang, Liuhe, Hailing, Gaoyou—upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: The counties were Jiangdu, Jiangyang, Liuhe, Hailing, and Gaoyou, all upper grade.

sentences.zh: 有隄塘，溉田數千頃，元和中，節度使李吉甫築。

translations.literal: There is an embankment irrigating fields of several thousand qing; in the Yuanhe era the military governor Li Jifu built it.
translations.idiomatic: An embankment there irrigates several thousand qing of fields; the military governor Li Jifu built it in the Yuanhe period.

sentences.zh: 揚子，望。永淳元年析江都置。天長。望。本千秋，天寶元年742年析江都、六合、高郵置，七載更名。有銅。

translations.literal: Yangzi was eminent; in Yongchun 1 it was divided from Jiangdu and established. Tianchang was eminent; originally Qianqiu, it was established in Tianbao 1 from Jiangdu, Liuhe, and Gaoyou, renamed in year seven, and had copper.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzi was an eminent county created from Jiangdu in Yongchun 1. Tianchang, originally Qianqiu, was formed from Jiangdu, Liuhe, and Gaoyou in Tianbao 1, renamed in Tianbao 7, and had copper.

translations.literal: Chu Prefecture, Huaiyin Commandery, was close-ranked.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Prefecture, Huaiyin Commandery, was close-ranked.

sentences.zh: 本江都郡之山陽、安宜縣地，臧君相據之，號東楚州。

translations.literal: Originally the territory of Shanyang and Anyi counties in Jiangdu commandery; Zang Junxiang held it and styled it Eastern Chu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Originally the lands of Shanyang and Anyi in Jiangdu commandery; Zang Junxiang seized them and called the seat Eastern Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 武德四年，君相降，因之，八年更名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Junxiang surrendered and it was so established; in the eighth year it was renamed.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 4 Junxiang submitted and the prefecture was established accordingly; in year 8 it received its present name.

translations.literal: Local tribute: coarse cloth and ramie cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Local tribute included coarse cloth and ramie cloth.

sentences.zh: 戶二萬六千六十二，口十五萬三千。

translations.literal: Households: twenty-six thousand sixty-two; persons: one hundred fifty-three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: It registered 26,062 households and 153,000 persons.

translations.literal: Four counties.
translations.idiomatic: Four counties.

sentences.zh: 涪川，中下。武德四年析務川置。貞觀四年以黔州之相永、萬資隸費州，十一年省。扶陽，中下。多田，中下。武德四年置，隸思州，貞觀元年隸務州，八年來屬。城樂。中下。武德四年招慰生獠置，隸思州，貞觀元年隸務州，八年來屬。南州南川郡，下。

translations.literal: Fuchuan was middle-lower-ranked. In Wude year four it was divided from Wuchuan and established. In Zhenguan year four Xiangyong and Wanzi of Qianzhou were assigned to Feizhou, and in year eleven they were abolished. Fuyang was middle-lower-ranked. Duotian was middle-lower-ranked. It was established in Wude year four and belonged to Sizhou; in Zhenguan year one it belonged to Wuzhou, and in year eight it came under this prefecture. Chengle was middle-lower-ranked. In Wude year four it was established by recruiting and pacifying the raw Lao, belonging to Sizhou; in Zhenguan year one it belonged to Wuzhou, and in year eight it came under this prefecture. Nanzhou, Nanchuan Commandery, was lower-ranked.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽，上。武德五年析置廣晉縣，隸浩州，八年州廢，省縣入焉。縣東有邵父堤，東北三里有李公堤，建中元年刺史李復築，以捍江水。東北四里有馬塘，北六里有土湖，皆刺史馬植築。餘干，上。武德四年置玉亭、長城二縣，七年省玉亭入長城，八年省長城入餘干。有神山。樂平，上。武德四年置，九年省，後復置。有金，有銀，有銅，有鐵。浮梁。上。本新平，武德四年析鄱陽置，八年省，開元四年復置，曰新昌，天寶元年更名。虔州南康郡，上。

translations.literal: Poyang was upper-ranked. In Wude year five Guangjin County was divided off and established, belonging to Haozhou; in year eight the province was abolished, and the county was abolished into Poyang. East of the county was Shaofu Dike; three li northeast was Duke Li's Dike, built by the prefect Li Fu in Jianzhong year one to guard against the river water. Four li northeast was Ma Pond, and six li north was Tu Lake, both built by the prefect Ma Zhi. Yugan was upper-ranked. In Wude year four Yuting and Changcheng counties were established; in year seven Yuting was abolished into Changcheng, and in year eight Changcheng was abolished into Yugan. It had Shen Mountain. Leping was upper-ranked. It was established in Wude year four, abolished in year nine, and later restored. It had gold, silver, copper, and iron. Fuliang was upper-ranked. It was originally Xinping; in Wude year four it was divided from Poyang and established, in year eight it was abolished, in Kaiyuan year four it was restored and called Xinchang, and in Tianbao year one its name was changed. Qianzhou, Nankang Commandery, was upper-ranked.
translations.idiomatic: Poyang was upper-ranked. In Wude year five Guangjin County was divided off and established, belonging to Haozhou; in year eight the province was abolished, and the county was abolished into Poyang. East of the county was Shaofu Dike; three li northeast was Duke Li's Dike, built by the prefect Li Fu in Jianzhong year one to guard against the river water. Four li northeast was Ma Pond, and six li north was Tu Lake, both built by the prefect Ma Zhi. Yugan was upper-ranked. In Wude year four Yuting and Changcheng counties were established; in year seven Yuting was abolished into Changcheng, and in year eight Changcheng was abolished into Yugan. It had Shen Mountain. Leping was upper-ranked. It was established in Wude year four, abolished in year nine, and later restored. It had gold, silver, copper, and iron. Fuliang was upper-ranked. It was originally Xinping; in Wude year four it was divided from Poyang and established, in year eight it was abolished, in Kaiyuan year four it was restored and called Xinchang, and in Tianbao year one its name was changed. Qianzhou, Nankang Commandery, was upper-ranked.

sentences.zh: 西安，望。本信安，武德四年析置定陽縣，六年省，咸通中更信安曰西安。東五十五里有神塘，開元五年，因風雷摧山，偃澗成塘，溉田二百頃。有銀。龍丘，緊。本太末，武德四年置，以縣置穀州，幷置白石縣，八年州廢。省太末、白石入信安。貞觀八年析信安、金華復置，更名龍丘，隸婺州。如意元年析置盈川縣。證聖二年置武安縣，後省武安。元和七年省盈川入信安。有岑山。須江，上。武德四年析信安置，八年省，永昌元年復置。常山。上。咸亨五年析信安置，隸婺州，垂拱二年來屬，乾元元年隸信州，後復故。處州縉雲郡，上。

translations.literal: Xi'an was eminent. It was originally Xin'an; in Wude year four Dingyang County was divided off and established, in year six it was abolished, and during Xiantong Xin'an was changed to Xi'an. Fifty-five li east was Shen Pond; in Kaiyuan year five, when wind and thunder shattered a mountain and blocked a stream to form a pond, it irrigated two hundred qing of fields. It had silver. Longqiu was close-ranked. It was originally Taimo. In Wude year four it was established, Guzhou was established from the county, and Baishi County was also established; in year eight the province was abolished. Taimo and Baishi were abolished into Xin'an. In Zhenguan year eight it was divided from Xin'an and Jinhua and restored, renamed Longqiu, and assigned to Wuzhou. In Ruyi year one Yingchuan County was divided off and established. In Zhengsheng year two Wu'an County was established, and later Wu'an was abolished. In Yuanhe year seven Yingchuan was abolished into Xin'an. It had Cen Mountain. Xujiang was upper-ranked. In Wude year four it was divided from Xin'an and established, in year eight it was abolished, and in Yongchang year one it was restored. Changshan was upper-ranked. In Xianheng year five it was divided from Xin'an and established, belonging to Wuzhou; in Chuigong year two it came under this prefecture, in Qianyuan year one it belonged to Xinzhou, and later its former status was restored. Chuzhou, Jinyun Commandery, was upper-ranked.

sentences.zh: 有江寧軍，乾元二年置。有石頭鎮兵。有下蜀、淮山二戍。上元，望。本江寧，隸潤州。武德三年以江寧、溧水二縣置揚州，析置丹楊、溧陽、安業三縣，更江寧曰歸化。七年平輔公祏，更名蔣州。八年，復為揚州，又以延陵、句容隸之，省安業入歸化，更歸化曰金陵。九年州廢，都督徙治江都，更名金陵曰白下，以白下、延陵、句容隸潤州，丹楊、溧水、溧陽隸宣州。貞觀九年更白下曰江寧，肅宗上元二年又更名。有銅，有鐵。有蔣山。句容，望。武德三年以句容、延陵二縣置茅州，七年州廢，隸蔣州，九年隸潤州。乾元元年來屬。西南三十里有絳巖湖，麟德中，令楊延嘉因梁故隄置，後廢，大曆十二年，令王昕復置，周百里為塘，立二斗門以節旱暵，開田萬頃。絳巖，故赤山，天寶中更名。有銅，有礬。溧水，上。乾元元年隸昇州，州廢，還隸宣州。有銅。溧陽。緊。上元元年隸昇州，州廢，還隸宣州。有湖山。有銅，有鐵。常州晉陵郡，望。

translations.literal: It had Jiangning Army, established in Qianyuan year two. It had troops at Shitou Fortified Town. It had two garrisons, Xiashu and Huaishan. Shangyuan was eminent. It was originally Jiangning and belonged to Runzhou. In Wude year three Yangzhou was established from Jiangning and Lishui counties; Danyang, Liyang, and Anye counties were divided off and established, and Jiangning was changed to Guihua. In year seven, after Fu Gongshi was pacified, it was renamed Jiangzhou. In year eight it again became Yangzhou, Yanling and Jurong were also assigned to it, Anye was abolished into Guihua, and Guihua was changed to Jinling. In year nine the province was abolished, the area commandant moved his seat to Jiangdu, Jinling was renamed Baixia, and Baixia, Yanling, and Jurong were assigned to Runzhou, while Danyang, Lishui, and Liyang were assigned to Xuanzhou. In Zhenguan year nine Baixia was changed to Jiangning, and in Suzong's Shangyuan year two the name was changed again. It had copper and iron. It had Jiang Mountain. Jurong was eminent. In Wude year three Maozhou was established from Jurong and Yanling counties; in year seven the province was abolished and it belonged to Jiangzhou; in year nine it belonged to Runzhou. In Qianyuan year one it came under this prefecture. Thirty li southwest was Jiangyan Lake; during Linde the magistrate Yang Yanjia established it on the basis of an old Liang dike. It was later abandoned, and in Dali year twelve the magistrate Wang Xin restored it, making a pond one hundred li around and setting up two sluice gates to regulate drought, thereby opening ten thousand qing of fields. Jiangyan was old Red Mountain, renamed during Tianbao. It had copper and alum. Lishui was upper-ranked. In Qianyuan year one it belonged to Shengzhou; when the province was abolished, it returned to Xuanzhou. It had copper. Liyang was close-ranked. In Shangyuan year one it belonged to Shengzhou; when the province was abolished, it returned to Xuanzhou. It had Lake Mountain. It had copper and iron. Changzhou, Jinling Commandery, was eminent.

sentences.zh: 有丹楊軍，乾元二年置，元和二年廢。丹徒，望。本延陵縣地，武德三年置。開元二十二年，刺史齊澣以州北隔江，舟行繞瓜步，回遠六十里，多風濤，乃於京口埭下直趨渡江二十里，開伊婁河二十五里，渡揚子，立埭，歲利百億，舟不漂溺。有勾驪山。丹楊，望。本曲阿。武德二年以縣置雲州。五年曰簡州，以縣南有簡瀆取名。八年州廢，來屬。天寶元年更名。有練塘，周八十里，永泰中，刺史韋損因廢塘復置，以溉丹楊、金壇、延陵之田，民刻石頌之。金壇，緊。本曲阿縣地。隋末，土人保聚，因為金山縣。隋亡，沈法興又置琅瑘縣，李子通以琅瑘置茅州，以金山隸之。賊平，因之，後隸蔣州。武德八年省入延陵。垂拱四年復置，來屬，更名。東南三十里有南、北謝塘，武德二年，刺史謝元超因故塘復置以溉田。延陵。緊。故治丹徒，武德三年別置，隸茅州，後隸蔣州，九年來屬。有茅山。昇州江寧郡，至德二載以潤州之江寧縣置，上元二年廢，光啟三年復以上元、句容、溧水、溧陽四縣置。

translations.literal: It had Danyang Army, established in Qianyuan year two and abolished in Yuanhe year two. Dantu was eminent. It was originally territory of Yanling County and was established in Wude year three. In Kaiyuan year twenty-two, because north of the prefecture lay across the Yangzi and boats traveling by Guabu made a sixty-li detour, with much wind and waves, the prefect Qi Han opened Yilou River for twenty-five li from below the Jingkou dam straight toward a twenty-li crossing of the Yangzi, and set up a dam; each year the benefit was enormous, and boats no longer drifted away or sank. It had Gouli Mountain. Danyang was eminent. It was originally Qu'e. In Wude year two Yunzhou was established from the county. In year five it was called Jianzhou, taking its name from Jian Creek south of the county. In year eight the province was abolished and it came under this prefecture. In Tianbao year one its name was changed. It had Lian Pond, eighty li around; during Yongtai, the prefect Wei Sun restored it from an abandoned pond to irrigate the fields of Danyang, Jintan, and Yanling, and the people carved a stone to praise him. Jintan was close-ranked. It was originally territory of Qu'e County. At the end of Sui, local people gathered there for protection, and it became Jinshan County. After Sui fell, Shen Faxing also established Langya County, and Li Zitong used Langya to establish Maozhou, assigning Jinshan to it. When the rebels were pacified, this arrangement was continued, and later it belonged to Jiangzhou. In Wude year eight it was abolished into Yanling. In Chuigong year four it was restored, came under this prefecture, and its name was changed. Thirty li southeast were Southern and Northern Xie ponds; in Wude year two the prefect Xie Yuanchao restored them from old ponds to irrigate fields. Yanling was close-ranked. Its old seat was Dantu; in Wude year three it was separately established and belonged to Maozhou, later to Jiangzhou, and in year nine came under this prefecture. It had Mao Mountain. Shengzhou, Jiangning Commandery, was established in Zhide year two from Jiangning County of Runzhou, abolished in Shangyuan year two, and restored in Guangqi year three from Shangyuan, Jurong, Lishui, and Liyang counties.

sentences.zh: 蘄春，上。武德四年省蘄水縣入焉。有鼓吹山。黃梅，上。武德四年置，以縣置南晉州，析置義豐、長吉、塘陽、新蔡四縣。八年州廢，省義豐、長吉、塘陽、新蔡，以黃梅來屬。廣濟，中。本永寧，武德四年析蘄春置，天寶元年更名。有鐵。蘄水。上。本浠水。武德四年更名蘭溪，省羅田縣入焉。天寶元年又更名。有鐵。安州安陸郡，中都督府。

translations.literal: Qichun was upper-ranked. In Wude year four Qishui County was abolished into it. It had Guchui Mountain. Huangmei was upper-ranked. It was established in Wude year four; Southern Jinzhou was established from the county, and Yifeng, Changji, Tangyang, and Xincai counties were divided off and established. In year eight the province was abolished; Yifeng, Changji, Tangyang, and Xincai were abolished, and Huangmei came under this prefecture. Guangji was middle-ranked. It was originally Yongning; in Wude year four it was divided from Qichun and established, and in Tianbao year one its name was changed. It had iron. Qishui was upper-ranked. It was originally Xishui. In Wude year four its name was changed to Lanxi, and Luotian County was abolished into it. In Tianbao year one its name was again changed. It had iron. Anzhou, Anlu Commandery, was a middle-ranking area command.

sentences.zh: 鹽城，上。本故漢鹽瀆縣地。隋末，盜韋徹據其地，置射州及射陽、安樂、新安三縣。武德四年來歸，因之。七年州廢，省射陽、安樂、新安，置鹽城縣。有鹽亭百二十三，有監。寶應，望。本安宜。武德四年以縣置倉州，七年州廢，來屬。上元三年以獲定國寶更名。西南八十里有白水塘、羨塘，證聖中開，置屯田。西南四十里有徐州涇、青州涇，西南五十里有大府涇，長慶中興白水塘屯田，發青、徐、揚州之民以鑿之，大府即揚州。北四里有竹子涇，亦長慶中開。淮陰。中。武德七年省，乾封二年析山陽復置。南九十五里有棠梨涇，長慶二年開。滁州永陽郡，上。

translations.literal: Yancheng was upper-ranked. It was originally the territory of the old Han county Yandu. At the end of Sui, the bandit Wei Che occupied the territory and established Shezhou together with Sheyang, Anle, and Xin'an counties. In Wude year four it submitted, and this arrangement was continued. In year seven the province was abolished, Sheyang, Anle, and Xin'an were abolished, and Yancheng County was established. It had 123 salt stations and had a superintendency. Baoying was eminent. It was originally Anyi. In Wude year four Cangzhou was established from the county; in year seven the province was abolished and it came under this prefecture. In Shangyuan year three its name was changed because a treasure that stabilized the state had been obtained. Eighty li southwest were Baishui Pond and Xian Pond, opened during Zhengsheng, with military colonies established there. Forty li southwest were Xuzhou Creek and Qingzhou Creek, and fifty li southwest was Dafu Creek; during Changqing the Baishui Pond military colonies were revived, and people from Qing, Xu, and Yang prefectures were mobilized to dig them; Dafu means Yangzhou. Four li north was Zhuzi Creek, also opened during Changqing. Huaiyin was middle-ranked. In Wude year seven it was abolished; in Qianfeng year two it was divided from Shanyang and restored. Ninety-five li south was Tangli Creek, opened in Changqing year two. Chuzhou, Yongyang Commandery, was upper-ranked.

sentences.zh: 務川，中下。武德元年置。貞觀元年，以廢夷州之寧夷、伏遠、思義、明陽、高富、丹川及廢思州之丹陽、城樂、感化、思王、多田隸務州，尋省思義、明陽、丹川，二年省丹陽，八年省感化，十年以高富隸黔州，十一年省伏遠。思王，中下。武德三年置。思邛。中下。開元四年開生獠置。費州涪川郡，下。

translations.literal: Wuchuan was middle-lower-ranked. It was established in Wude year one. In Zhenguan year one, Ningyi, Fuyuan, Siyi, Mingyang, Gaofu, and Danchuan of abolished Yizhou and Danyang, Chengle, Ganhua, Siwang, and Duotian of abolished Sizhou were assigned to Wuzhou. Soon Siyi, Mingyang, and Danchuan were abolished; in year two Danyang was abolished; in year eight Ganhua was abolished; in year ten Gaofu was assigned to Qianzhou; and in year eleven Fuyuan was abolished. Siwang was middle-lower-ranked. It was established in Wude year three. Siqiong was middle-lower-ranked. In Kaiyuan year four it was established by opening territory of the raw Lao. Feizhou, Fuchuan Commandery, was lower-ranked.

Forty li west was Meng Channel, which drew Yangzi water southward to connect transport and irrigate four thousand qing of fields; in Yuanhe year eight the prefect Meng Jian opened it on the basis of an old canal. Jiangyin was eminent. In Wude year three Jizhou was established from the county, and Jiyang and Licheng counties were also divided off and established. In year nine the province was abolished, Jiyang and Licheng were abolished, and Jiangyin came under this prefecture. Yixing was close-ranked. In Wude year seven Southern Xingzhou was established from the county, and Linjin and Yangxian counties were also divided off and established. In year eight the province was abolished, Yangxian and Linjin were abolished, and Yixing came under this prefecture. It had Zhanggong Mountain. Wuxi was eminent. Five li south was Taibo Channel, which connected eastward with Li Lake; it too was opened by Meng Jian in Yuanhe year eight. Suzhou, Wu Commandery, was strong.

sentences.zh: 武康，上。李子通置安州，又曰武州。武德四年平子通，因之，七年州廢，縣隸湖州。有封山。有銅。長城，望。大業末沈法興置長州。武德四年更置綏州，因古綏安縣名之，又更名雉州，幷置原鄉縣。七年州廢，省原鄉，以長城來屬。有西湖，溉田三千頃，其後堙廢，貞元十三年，刺史于頔復之，人賴其利。顧山有茶，以供貢。有銅。安吉，緊。義寧二年沈法興置。武德四年賊平，因之，以縣隸桃州。七年，省入長城。麟德元年復置。北三十里有邸閣池，北十七里有石鼓堰，引天目山水溉田百頃，皆聖曆初令鉗耳知命置。有銅，有錫。德清。上。本武源，天授二年析武康置，景雲二年曰臨溪，天寶元年更名。杭州餘杭郡，上。

translations.literal: Wukang was upper-ranked. Li Zitong established Anzhou, also called Wuzhou. In Wude year four Zitong was pacified and the arrangement was continued; in year seven the province was abolished and the county belonged to Huzhou. It had Feng Mountain. It had copper. Changcheng was eminent. At the end of Daye Shen Faxing established Changzhou. In Wude year four Suizhou was established in its place, named from the ancient Sui'an County; it was also renamed Zhizhou, and Yuanxiang County was established. In year seven the province was abolished, Yuanxiang was abolished, and Changcheng came under this prefecture. It had West Lake, irrigating three thousand qing of fields; afterward it silted up and was abandoned, and in Zhenyuan year thirteen the prefect Yu Di restored it, so the people relied on its benefits. Gu Mountain had tea for tribute. It had copper. Anji was close-ranked. Shen Faxing established it in Yining year two. In Wude year four, after the rebels were pacified, the arrangement was continued, and the county was assigned to Taozhou. In year seven it was abolished into Changcheng. In Linde year one it was restored. Thirty li north was Dige Pond, and seventeen li north was Shigu Weir, which drew Tianmu Mountain water to irrigate one hundred qing of fields; both were established at the beginning of Shengli by the magistrate Qian'er Zhiming. It had copper and tin. Deqing was upper-ranked. Hangzhou, Yuhang Commandery, was upper-ranked.

sentences.zh: 有采石軍，乾元二年置，元和六年廢。宣城，望。武德三年析置懷安縣，六年省。東十六里有德政陂，引渠溉田二百頃，大曆二年觀察使陳少遊置。有敬亭山。當塗，緊。武德三年以縣置南豫州，八年州廢，來屬。貞觀元年省丹楊縣入焉。乾元元年隸昇州，上元二年復來屬。有神武山。有采石戍。有銅，有鐵。涇，緊。武德三年以縣置南徐州，尋更名猷州，幷置南陽、安吳二縣。八年州廢，省南陽、安吳，以涇來屬。廣德，緊。本綏安。武德三年以縣置桃州，幷置桐陳、懷德二縣。七年州廢，省桐陳、懷德，以綏安來屬。至德二載更名。有橫山。南陵，望。武德四年隸池州，州廢來屬。後析置義安縣，又廢義安為銅官冶。利國山有銅，有鐵。鳳凰山有銀。有大農陂，溉田千頃，元和四年，寧國令范某因廢陂置，為石堰三百步，水所及者六十里。有永豐陂，在青弋江中，咸通五年置。有鵲頭鎮兵。有梅根、宛陵二監錢官。太平，上。

Sixteen li east was Dezheng Embankment, which drew a canal to irrigate two hundred qing of fields; the surveillance commissioner Chen Shaoyou established it in Dali year two. It had Yongfeng Embankment, in the Qingyi River, established in Xiantong year five. It had troops at Quetou Fortified Town. It had two coin-mint superintendencies, Meigen and Wanling. Taiping was upper-ranked.
